Graded `priority:p0` and typed `Bug` on that basis — the release lane refuses to push, and nobody would find out until a cut was attempted.

ACCEPT. Verified against the branch and `origin/main`, not against the report.

- **File surface held exactly**: PR #9553 changes one file, `.github/workflows/cut-rc.yml`, +72/−13. The fix for a fourth offending path lives inside that same file, so finding more than the card named did not widen the diff beyond its declared surface.
- **`Fixes #9518` is the first body line**; labels `ci/cd, size/s, skip-changeset`.
- **The "read, don't restate" ruling was satisfied by the better route**, and I checked the premise rather than the claim: `SURFACES` really is `export const` in `scripts/check-docs-image-tag.mjs`, and `sync-docs-image-tags.mjs` really does import it. This step joining as the third consumer of one declaration is the shape the ruling asked for.
- **The non-wildcard property is structural, not just asserted.** The re-check filters staged paths with `grep -vxF -f` against the very list that was staged — whole-line, fixed-string. The PR body's own reason for that choice is the kind of detail that decides correctness later: an unescaped ERE alternation spelling `README.md` would have accepted `READMEXmd`.
- **The requirement I would have sent this back for is met.** Leg 3 shows the assertion still fails on a `content/docs` page `SURFACES` does not name; legs 4 and 5 show the two new guards refuse the cut when the declaration is unresolvable or empty. A gate that can no longer fail would have been worse than the bug — that is why it was demanded before the work started, and it was answered with output rather than argument.
- **CI**: the `Check Changeset` failure at 09:23 is superseded by its 09:27 re-run, `skipped`, after `skip-changeset` landed. Everything else is `success` or skipped by path filter, as a workflow-only diff should be. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Console Pin Freshness`, `Part-of` and the same-issue guard all green.
- **`skip-changeset` is the right call and was justified from the diff** rather than applied to clear a red: one workflow file, no package published, nothing shipped to consumers.

**One correction, and it is against me.** I started to flag the fourth path's attribution as wrong — nothing in `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` named `objectstack.manifest.json` or `TEXT_STAMPS`. I was reading the shared checkout, whose HEAD sits at this morning's `5904b0500`. On `origin/main` (`b348ac2c2`) that script has grown from 3,388 to 10,818 bytes and does exactly what the report says. The attribution is correct; the stale read was mine. Recording it because this repo's own rule — verify against `origin/main`, never the shared working tree — exists precisely for the near-miss I just had, and a reviewer who skips it publishes a confident, wrong correction.

Landing: flipping to ready and enabling auto-merge. #9498 rebases onto this once it lands, per the sequencing on #9465.

Landed and verified on `origin/main` as `955ccf20d` — *fix(ci): stage what the version pass actually writes in cut-rc.yml (#9553)*.

Checked by content rather than by sha ancestry, since the queue lands changes as a squash and the reviewed sha is therefore not an ancestor of `main`. On `origin/main:.github/workflows/cut-rc.yml`:

- `SURFACE_LIST` resolved at run time (line 550) with both guards — unresolvable (553) and empty (560) — present;
- `mapfile -t DOCS_SURFACES` feeding the staging pathspec (564);
- the fourth path, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.manifest.json`, in the allowlist (575);
- the re-check's whole-line exact filter `grep -vxF -f "$SURFACE_LIST"` (592).

**What this unblocks:** the next RC cut can push again. It had been refusing on every attempt since #9064 joined `sync-docs-image-tags.mjs` to the `version` script, and nobody would have found out until someone tried to cut — which is why this was graded p0 the moment the rehearsal surfaced it, ahead of the migration that found it.

Follow-ups left open deliberately, both filed by the same run: #9554 (`sync-template-versions.mjs` declares its stamp targets but exports none and has no entry-point guard, so this workflow must still name two template paths literally — and both hardcode `blank`, which re-opens this defect the day a second template ships) and #9555 (local `pnpm run version` rehearsals hang forever in this container on a shallow checkout; carries the working scaffold). Neither blocks anything today.

Closing as completed.
